Proven reliability, quiet operation
System Power 11 M 850W is a modular ATX 3.1 PSU for value-oriented PC builders who do not want to pass on reliability and quietness.
80 PLUS® Gold efficiency (up to 91.2%)ATX 3.1 PSU with support for PCIe 5.1 GPUs and GPUs with 6+2 pin connectorsTemperature-controlled 120mm quality fan reduces system noiseRock-solid stability with a strong 12V-railTight voltage regulation using DC-to-DC technologyModular black sleeved and flat cablesOne PCIe 5.1 12V-2x6 600W and 3 PCIe 6-2 connectors for high-end GPUsStand-by drain of less than 0.1 watts

80 PLUS® GOLD CERTIFICATION
Very high operating efficiency
System Power 11 M 850W is certified 80 PLUS Gold with an outstanding efficiency rating of up to 91.2%. The most compelling benefit: lower power consumption, consequently lower costs, and above all a cooler as well as quieter operation. System Power 11 M 850W is always the correct choice for quiet systems and gaming PCs!
FUTURE-PROOF YOUR SYSTEM
Fulfills all ATX 3.1 specifications
System Power 11 M 850W is an ATX 3.1 PSU and comes with both native integration of the 12V-2x6 connector for next-generation PCIe 5.1 graphics cards, and PCIe 6+2-pin connectors for support of current-gen GPUs. It handles power excursions up to double its rated power with ease. This makes the PSU versatile and the perfect choice for systems of today and the ones to come.
VERY QUIET OPERATION
High-quality fan for low noise
System Power 11 M 850W is equipped with a temperature-controlled 120mm quality fan. It provides the low noise operation that be quiet! is famous for, offering remarkable quietness at this price level.
HIGH PERFORMANCE FOR YOUR SYSTEM
Proven reliability for CPU and GPU
System Power 11 M 850W provides stable and dependable power for CPU and GPU. This ensures a steady and reliable operation even when your PC meets an unexpectedly heavy load.
STRONG 12V RAIL
For a stable PCIe graphics support
System Power 11 M 850W provides enough power for demanding graphics cards. Safety protections defend against overcurrents, over- and undervoltages, overtemperature, short circuits, and overloads, thus keeping your valuable components safe.
MODULAR CABLES
Utmost convenience and compatibility
Thanks to their modularity, all unnecessary cables in the system are left out. System Power 11 M 850W simplifies cable management and routing for a tidy-looking system. A smoother airflow results from the uncluttered layout of the system, which means lower noise and temperatures inside the case.
